name: Nyquist telegraph transmission analysis
description: Analysis of signalling speed, coding, pulse shape and limited-band telegraph transmission.

date.basis: Date stated by the cited source; see event scope.

events.statement: Nyquist presented an analysis of telegraph signal shaping and coding at the February 1924 AIEE meeting.

evidence.supports: Nyquist analyzes signal shaping and coding; his convention presentation was February 1924.

events.caveats: Not a claim for all telegraph theory or the later general sampling theorem.
